notes.title: Thank you for playing Balloon Hater during Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[p]Hi friends!

Steam Next Fest has ended, and I’m truly grateful to everyone who visited the Balloon Hater page and tried the demo. It really means a lot to me 🙌

🎮 If you didn’t get a chance to play — no worries! The demo is still available, so you can jump in anytime and pop some balloons 😎

If you enjoyed the game, I’d really appreciate it if you added it to your wishlist — it helps the project a lot!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3540880/Balloon_Hater"][/dynamiclink]

Thanks for your support!

– Nikorych[/p]

notes.title: Balloon Hater at Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

My game Balloon Hater is taking part in Steam Next Fest! 🎉
It’s a great opportunity to try the demo and learn more about the game.

🕹 [b]The demo is available only until June 16[/b], so don’t miss your chance to play and share your impressions!

👁  [b]Don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist to stay updated with the latest news![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3540880/Balloon_Hater
Hope you enjoy it!

– Nikorych

notes.title: Balloon Hater demo is now live!
notes.content:
[b]Hi everyone![/b]

I’m excited to announce that the Balloon Hater demo is now available on Steam! 🎉
I decided to release it a bit ahead of Steam Next Fest so you’d have more time to check it out.

[h3]What’s in the Demo?[/h3]
[list]
[*] 3 types of balloons
[*] 10+ special bonus balloons
[*] 3 areas
[*] 8 weapons
[*] 40+ upgrades
[*] Drones, prestige, offline rewards
[/list]
[b]The demo will only be available from May 29 to June 16, so don’t miss it![/b]

Your feedback means a lot to me — feel free to share your thoughts, bug reports, and suggestions in the Steam discussions or through the forms:
✍️ Feedback
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScSX3crvm6TmIICQGdiwhY48tCxm9RNewcoiIBTS0K-uRkHxQ/viewform

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdHsEkjJ2mWh2rrmbvl2iaHH1itFgHFWNvfDLa_DiAomO3ztw/viewform

👁[b] And don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3540880/Balloon_Hater
Thanks for your support!

– Nikorych
